## *IMPORTANT: This competition will be hosting a Dual Round for the first and second rounds of 3x3x3 cube. Please see the [DUAL ROUND!](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BurnabyHandWarmers2027#81477-dual-round) tab for more information.*

To get updates about future BC and/or Canadian competitions, join the [Speedcubing Canada mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz).
You are also welcome to join the Facebook group
[Rubik's Cube Solvers British Columbia](https://www.facebook.com/groups/8336572494).

**Time Zone Reminder for U.S. Competitors: Effective November 2026, British Columbia will remain on daylight saving time year-round. As such, Vancouver will be one hour ahead of Washington state on the date of this competition. Please account for this time difference when planning your travel!**

Please **review all of the tabs on this website**. You **only need to show up for events that you're competing in**, but we encourage you to stay longer. Note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly in the afternoon — **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case. An email with information and reminders will be sent a few days before the competition.

**Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media, and other digital platforms.
